text:
You need a full-stack web app for desktop and mobile that combines affiliate product search with GPT-based results, and that can be calibrated as more data comes in.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience, and I’d be a strong fit for this build. I work with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS, so I’m comfortable taking a project from Figma designs through to a working production app.

For a recent project, I built a multilingual documentation site for Gridbeam Robotics using Next.js, MDX, and Algolia. The site launched in 4 languages with instant search, and support tickets went down 27%. That project required careful information structure, a clean user experience, and a setup that could scale as content evolved.

I also built a booking platform for Pulsebox Studios using Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma, and Stripe. It was a white-label class booking app where each studio had its own subdomain, timetable, and memberships. That platform onboarded 64 studios in 6 months and reached 71% checkout conversion. That experience is relevant here because your app will need a robust full-stack foundation, user flow clarity, and a structure that can support future growth.

For your project, I’d focus on:
- Translating the Figma designs into a responsive desktop/mobile interface
- Building the product search flow and GPT-driven result experience
- Creating the backend architecture to support query handling and data growth
- Setting up the app so the GPT behavior can be refined as more data is added

I’d be glad to discuss how the search logic, GPT calibration, and full-stack implementation should work in practice. If you’d like, we can walk through the product goals, user journey, and technical scope on a call or in private messaging so I can help map out the best approach.
